source.title: Malware uses LLMs to rank victims by how much they're worth
source.author: khalidkhair

title.zh: VOLTA信息窃取器用AI评估受害者价值
title.en: VOLTA Infostealer Uses AI to Rank Victim Value

excerpt.zh: VOLTA信息窃取器会把窃取和补充收集的个人数据交给大型语言模型，生成资产价值与安全状况评估，帮助操作者优先挑选目标。
excerpt.en: The VOLTA infostealer sends stolen and enriched personal data to a language model for victim assessments, helping operators prioritize targets by potential value.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: VOLTA信息窃取器在窃取凭证后，还会调用大型语言模型评估受害者可能具有的变现价值。Cisco Talos披露，这一名为VOLTA-AUTODOXER的Windows恶意软件，会把收集到的资料整理成受害者档案，再将其交给模型分析。
text.en: The VOLTA infostealer uses a large language model after stealing credentials to assess a victim’s potential value to criminals. Cisco Talos reports that the Windows malware, identified as VOLTA-AUTODOXER, assembles collected information into a victim profile and sends it to a model for analysis.

text.zh: VOLTA将零散数据整理成目标评估
text.en: VOLTA turns collected data into target assessments

text.zh: 窃取内容可能包括浏览器密码、会话令牌、支付卡资料、加密货币钱包信息，以及云服务和通信账户凭证。恶意软件还会利用被盗会话查找邮件收据、外卖订单等记录，以补充地址和账户资料。随后，模型受命按潜在变现价值排列资产，并评估受害者的安全习惯。
text.en: Stolen information can include browser passwords, session tokens, payment-card details, cryptocurrency wallet data, and credentials for cloud and communication accounts. The malware can also reuse stolen sessions to search for receipts and food-delivery orders, adding address and account details. The model is then asked to rank assets by potential monetization value and assess the victim’s security practices.

text.zh: AI降低分析负担，但风险规模仍待观察
text.en: AI reduces analysis work, but its broader impact is unclear

text.zh: Talos称，VOLTA在模型拒绝时配置了多个模型的回退链，也可以在没有模型调用的情况下运行。这表明AI在此处承担的是情报分析工作，而非传统的凭证窃取本身；它把原本需要操作者筛查资料的步骤自动化。报告推测该恶意软件可能采用可定制构建方式，但这并不能单独证明其销售模式或实际使用范围。
text.en: Talos says VOLTA has a multi-model fallback chain for refusals and can also operate without an AI call. Here, the model performs intelligence analysis rather than the underlying credential theft, automating a step that would otherwise require an operator to sort through the data. The report suggests the malware may use customizable builds, but that alone does not establish how it is sold or how widely it is used.

text.zh: 对防御方而言，风险在于被盗资料经过关联后更容易用于定向勒索或诈骗。Talos建议限制非授权进程以无头模式启动Chrome，并在发现感染后撤销可能泄露的令牌、修改密码；若钱包助记词曾以明文存放，应视为已失陷。AI是否会实质扩大犯罪规模，或主要是降低操作者的分析门槛，仍是开放问题。
text.en: For defenders, the concern is that linking stolen records can make them more useful for targeted extortion or fraud. Talos recommends restricting unauthorized processes from launching Chrome in headless mode. After a suspected infection, users should revoke potentially exposed tokens and change passwords; if a wallet seed phrase was stored in plaintext, the wallet should be treated as compromised. Whether AI materially expands criminal operations or mainly lowers the analysis burden remains an open question.
